title: Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo Tacos
description: A creative twist on Italian chicken fettuccine alfredo, served in a crispy taco shell.
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the roasted garlic, Algerian spices, and Parmesan cheese to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook until the cheese is melted.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss to combine.
Warm the taco shells by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the chicken and fettuccine mixture into the taco shells.
Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and chopped parsley.
